yt_description:
Some FJ Cruiser owners are on their third or fourth windshield. More than 60 NHTSA complaints across the 2007–2014 model years describe cracked windshields: the nearly upright glass takes the full force of every rock. One IH8MUD member paid $50 for a chip repair; early replacement quotes on IH8MUD ran about $1,600–1,800 with dealer glass. If it has to be replaced, have the shop order a new top molding too (it often gets ruined coming off).

The full guide: https://boxytrucks.com/repairs/land-cruiser/fj-cruiser/repair-a-chip-before-the-windshield-cracks/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social

Photos: Brice Cooper / Unsplash. Voiceover is AI-generated.
yt_comment: FJ windshield notes from our guide: more than 60 NHTSA complaints (2007–2014) describe cracked windshields, some after a pothole or cold weather. A resin repair kept one IH8MUD member's small crack from spreading. If you replace it, order a new top molding too (one member's dealer molding was about $278), and another member listed PPG FW02652 as the replacement glass. After a replacement, check for leaks at the top molding and A-pillars in the first rain. Full guide: https://boxytrucks.com/repairs/land-cruiser/fj-cruiser/repair-a-chip-before-the-windshield-cracks/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=comment How many windshields has yours had?
